findings.title: The ledger never states what tells hass-hassette an instance's entities are usable
findings.why_it_matters: The listing serves stopped instances' entities while commands admit only live owners; spec 158 never carries parent D9's status==running availability rule.
findings.recommended: A: Carry parent D9's rule in Assumed and the client docs
findings.chosen: A: Carry parent D9's rule in Assumed and the client docs

findings.title: Entities ride on GET /apps/{key} and the dashboard grid with no revision to order them, and no UI reads them there
findings.why_it_matters: D5 put entities on every AppSummary response while only the listing carries a revision, and D7 removed the only other reader.
findings.recommended: A: Attach entities only on the listing response
findings.chosen: A: Attach entities only on the listing response

findings.title: Whether the new AppListResponse fields are required or defaulted is unstated
findings.why_it_matters: Defaults would let a response without the fields pass the apply rule silently.
findings.chosen: In D4's Recommendation, add: Both fields are required, with no defaults: boot_id: str, revision: int.

findings.title: The apply semantics of boot_id and revision aren't planned for the wire docstrings
findings.why_it_matters: Consumers read the contract from the wire docstrings; without the rules they may compare across boots or require strictly newer listings.
findings.chosen: In D4's Recommendation, add that the fields' docstrings state parent D3's apply semantics.

findings.title: The 202 response's status is planned as a closed literal
findings.why_it_matters: A closed Literal would fail an older client's parse if a later 202 status is added.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.choice_reason: Seems silly to leave as a future breaking change

findings.title: Neither 409 says whether retrying can succeed
findings.why_it_matters: instance_not_running covered typos and removed apps as well as restarting instances.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: Revise D2: admission first, then a NOT_RUNNING rejection for a non-existent target answers app_not_found/instance_not_found (404)
findings.choice_reason: Asked why 404 was avoided; picked a new option that keeps admission's single authority

findings.title: A running orphan of a wholly removed app is commandable but never listed
findings.why_it_matters: D2's orphan rationale covers fewer cases than it reads as covering.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: The 202 gives the consumer nothing to order its follow-up refresh against
Lenient forward-compat depends on callers passing LENIENT_CONTEXT, and value's closed type will break the listing
Entity availability is inferred from status, which revision doesn't order
findings.why_it_matters: Availability is a status-derived rule outside revision's ordering; the revision docstring claimed to reflect every change.
findings.choice_reason: Chosen autonomously on Jessica's standing instruction to use best judgement while away

findings.title: Route tests run against a hand-copied admission, and any other dispatch result reads as success
findings.why_it_matters: Nothing pinned the real route-to-service pairing; a new CommandDispatchResult would answer 202.
findings.recommended: A: One real-service route test plus explicit result handling
findings.chosen: A: One real-service route test plus explicit result handling
findings.choice_reason: Chosen autonomously on Jessica's standing instruction

findings.title: instance_not_running tells clients to retry for disabled and --app-blocked apps, which never start
findings.why_it_matters: D2 promised each rejection says whether a retry can succeed; disabled/blocked apps never start.
findings.choice_reason: Chosen autonomously on Jessica's standing instruction

findings.title: The AppListResponse docstring promises ordering against WebSocket messages that don't exist yet
findings.why_it_matters: A public docstring promised semantics #4220 hasn't designed.
findings.chosen: Drop the WebSocket clause from the AppListResponse docstring and regenerate the schema

findings.title: A refused command logs the unvalidated key and instance_name path segments raw
findings.why_it_matters: Percent-decoded newlines in path segments could forge log lines.
findings.choice_reason: Security finding; chosen autonomously on Jessica's standing instruction

findings.title: A command dropped during shutdown still gets a 202
findings.why_it_matters: send_event drops events after streams close and returns normally, so the 202 is inferred.
findings.choice_reason: Recorded as KI-001; chosen autonomously on Jessica's standing instruction

findings.title: GET /api/apps now grows with every entity's attributes, with no size bound
findings.why_it_matters: Audience assumption: apps with many large-attribute sensors.

findings.title: set_switch(on=...) turns the switch on for any truthy non-bool
findings.why_it_matters: An untyped caller passing a string toggles the switch the wrong way.

findings.title: The 202 is non-idempotent, so the docs should tell hass-hassette not to retry presses
The 404-versus-409 choice reads a second state source after admission
